elements.element: Cap applies mutually to both parties
elements.evidence: "IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S LIABILITY FOR ANY MATTER ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO THIS AGREEMENT"

elements.element: Cap limb (a): fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim
elements.evidence: "(A) fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim"

elements.element: Cap limb (b): USD 1,000,000, taken as the greater of the two

elements.evidence: "NEITHER PARTY SHALL BE LIABLE FOR ANY INDIRECT OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES."

elements.element: Uncapped carve-out for breach of confidentiality obligations
elements.evidence: "SHALL NOT APPLY TO EITHER PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY ... OBLIGATIONS"

elements.element: Uncapped carve-out for data protection obligations
Uncapped carve-out for infringement of the other party's IP
elements.evidence: "ITS INFRINGEMENT OF THE OTHER PARTY'S INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS"

elements.element: Customer's payment obligations are not damages for cap purposes
elements.evidence: "Customer's payment obligations, being Client's obligations to pay all amounts due under this Agreement, are not damages."

elements.element: Fallback: mutual cap of 12 months' fees
elements.evidence: "EITHER PARTY'S LIABILITY ... EXCEED THE GREATER OF (A) fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim AND (B) USD 1,000,000" (mutual, fee-based cap present)

elements.element: Fallback: carve-outs for indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct
elements.evidence: "CONFIDENTIALITY ... INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS, ITS GROSS NEGLIGENCE, WILLFUL MISCONDUCT"

reasons: All preferred atomic elements are present: mutual, Agreement-wide cap at the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000; mutual indirect/consequential exclusion; the full uncapped carve-out list (confidentiality, data protection, security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, other party's IP infringement); and payment obligations excluded from damages.

The edit is a targeted operator/party/number substitution in the cap sentence plus one concise insertion supplying the absent exclusion, carve-out and payment-obligation language; the Client indemnity paragraph and all other terms are untouched.

The appositive "being Client's obligations to pay all amounts due under this Agreement" is a permissible short gloss because the document defines "Client" rather than "Customer"; it cures an otherwise undefined term rather than adding new substance.

Noted only in rationale: the retained original parenthetical "OTHER THAN DUE TO A BREACH RESULTING FROM TRUELINK'S GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT" is one-sided and now partly duplicative of the new mutual carve-out, but it is untouched original wording and does not narrow our protection.
